import asyncio
import os
from pathlib import Path
from chupa.git import Git
from chupa.seams import SubprocessExec
from chupa.specs import required_units, resolve_plan_contract, entry_unit_gap, PlanContractError

async def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env=os.environ, timeout=30)
    print('HEAD:', await git.rev_parse(root, 'HEAD'))
    print('status:', repr(await git.status_porcelain(root)))
    plan = await git._run(root, 'show', 'HEAD:CHUPA_PLAN.md')
    print('working plan equals committed:', plan == (root / 'CHUPA_PLAN.md').read_text())
    cites = ('19.L', '19.I', '19.P5', '19.P5.status-projection', '19.P5.baseline-binding-reader', '13', '12')

        for uid in required_units(plan, stem, ids):
            print(uid, 'gap:', entry_unit_gap(plan, uid))
        try:
            resolve_plan_contract(plan, ids)
            print('contract resolves')
        except PlanContractError as exc:
            print('contract resolution failed:', str(exc))
asyncio.run(main())
